titleEn: Using “be under no obligation to + verb”

formula: Subject + be + under no obligation + to + base verb

formulas.formula: Subject + be + under no obligation + to + base verb

example: Employees are under no obligation to answer work messages at midnight.
exampleZh: 僱員沒有義務在午夜回覆工作訊息。

examples.en: Employees are under no obligation to answer work messages at midnight.
examples.zh: 僱員沒有義務在午夜回覆工作訊息。
examples.highlight: Employees are under no obligation to answer work messages at midnight.

rules.zh: 在 be under no obligation to 中，be 動詞必須配合主語和時態：I 配 am，單數人物配 is 或 was，複數人物配 are 或 were，未來情況可用 will be。
rules.en: be I am under no obligation one person is under no obligation people are under no obligation one person was under no obligation people were under no obligation people will be under no obligation

rules.zh: 在 be under no obligation to 後面，to 必須接動詞原形，例如 answer、pay 或 explain；不可接 -ing 形式、過去式或過去分詞。
rules.en: to You are under no obligation to answer. Visitors are under no obligation to pay. The patient was under no obligation to explain. You are under no obligation to answering. Visitors are under no obligation to paid.

rules.zh: 已經包含否定意思正確：【You are under no obligation to reply.】 不要寫：【You are not under no obligation to reply.】 後一句形成不必要的雙重否定，意思亦可能變得混亂。
rules.en: no You are under no obligation to reply. You are not under no obligation to reply.

rules.zh: 沒有義務不等於「不准」意思是：你可以出席，也可以選擇不出席。它不表示：你不准出席。因此，這個句型表達的是自由選擇，而不是禁止。
rules.en: You are under no obligation to attend.

rules.zh: 不要把 “to” 誤解為表達目的在以下句子中：【Customers are under no obligation to buy anything.】 以【to buy】為例：補充說明顧客「沒有義務做甚麼。它並不是：顧客為了購物而沒有義務。」整個固定結構應理解為：【be under no obligation to do something】
rules.en: Customers are under no obligation to buy anything. be under no obligation to do something

rules.zh: 必須清楚指出沒有義務的人較含糊：【There is no obligation to reply.】 較清楚：【Recipients are under no obligation to reply.】 第二句明確指出誰沒有義務回覆。
rules.en: There is no obligation to reply. Recipients are under no obligation to reply.

rules.zh: 不應把程度較弱的意思改得過強但是，如果原句只是：【You may not need to give your name.】 它只表示「可能不需要」，不一定能改成肯定的：【You are under no obligation to give your name.】 改寫時必須保留原句的肯定程度。
rules.en: Source: Giving your name is optional. Suitable answer: You are under no obligation to give your name. You may not need to give your name. You are under no obligation to give your name.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚說明某項行動屬於自願性質，當事人可以自行決定是否去做。第二句直接把焦點放在「你沒有義務回答」，因此更清楚說明當事人的選擇權。
benefits.en: It clearly tells people what is optional This structure makes it clear that a person may choose whether to do something. Compare: Answering the final question is optional. You are under no obligation to answer the final question.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以有禮貌地說明個人的權利和界線，而不需要使用過於直接或帶有衝突性的語氣。兩句意思相近，但第二句較適合正式通知、政策說明和專業溝通。
benefits.en: It helps explain rights and boundaries politely Instead of giving a blunt instruction, this structure explains that another person cannot reasonably require the action. You do not have to explain yourself. You are under no obligation to explain yourself.

benefits.zh: 這個表達適合用於：公司政策申請表研究和問卷服務條款活動通知正式電郵合約或協議說明它能準確指出哪些事情是必須的，哪些事情可以自由選擇。
benefits.en: It is useful in policies, agreements and formal messages The expression is common when explaining rules relating to work, services, applications, surveys and voluntary activities.

benefits.zh: 以【“optional”】為例：有時只表示某件事不是強制的，但未必清楚指出誰擁有選擇權。第二句清楚指出，是申請人沒有義務提供照片。
benefits.en: It avoids vague words such as “optional” The word optional may not always show who has the choice. Providing a photograph is optional. Applicants are under no obligation to provide a photograph.

benefits.zh: 你可以在核心句型前後加入：條件原因時間政策來源對比適用對象這樣可以在一個句子內同時說明背景和選擇權，使內容更完整。
benefits.en: It allows you to add useful details naturally You can add information before or around the core expression without changing it. Even after receiving the information pack, families are under no obligation to enrol their child.

benefits.zh: 學生不需要在文章中不斷重複：【do not have to；are not required to；it is optional；can choose not to】 使用這個句型可以增加句式變化，同時保持意思清晰。
benefits.en: It gives formal writing more sentence variety Instead of repeatedly writing “do not have to” or “it is optional”, learners can use this structure as another accurate option. do not have to are not required to it is optional can choose not to
